epics.title: Core Vault, Privacy Quarantine & Security Boundaries
epics.summary: Harden local SQLite storage permissions, isolate @me direct messages, enforce HTTPS Discord CDN attachment allowlists, and prevent user token handling.

issues.title: Harden bun:sqlite WAL and FTS5 schema with 0600 file permissions
issues.problem: Local message archives must support sub 15 ms full text search without exposing readable database files on disk.
issues.desiredBehavior: RadarVault creates parent directories with 0700 mode, sets 0600 on the SQLite file, enables WAL mode, and syncs FTS5 triggers cleanly.
acceptanceCriteria: Initialize messages and messages_fts tables idempotently.
Sanitize user search tokens before building FTS5 MATCH clauses.
issues.verification: bun test passes FTS5 search assertions cleanly.

issues.title: Enforce @me DM quarantine and credential secret redaction
issues.problem: Local Discord desktop caches store private direct messages alongside guild discussions and secrets can leak into error output.
issues.desiredBehavior: All @me, dm, and direct_message inputs are skipped before SQLite insertion, filtered from all SELECT queries, and tokens are scrubbed from errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Reject mfa user session tokens in assertSafeBotToken.
Guarantee zero @me rows appear in search, recent, or stats results.
issues.verification: bun test verifies zero @me leak across mixed payloads.

issues.title: Enforce strict HTTPS port 443 Discord CDN attachment allowlist
issues.problem: Unvalidated attachment URLs from external chat caches pose SSRF and credential leak risks.
issues.desiredBehavior: Only HTTPS URLs on default port 443 targeting cdn.discordapp.com, media.discordapp.net, or images-ext-<digits>.discordapp.net are retained.
acceptanceCriteria: Reject HTTP, localhost, IPv4/IPv6 literals, non 443 ports, and embedded credentials.
Return rejectedAttachmentCount inside IngestSummary.
issues.verification: bun test asserts 100% rejection across invalid CDN test vectors.

epics.title: Tier 1, Tier 2 & Tier 3 Multi Source Ingestion
epics.summary: Collect messages safely across owned servers via official Bot API, external servers via zero network wiretap caches, and web channels via OpenCLI/Chrome snapshots.

issues.title: Add official Bot REST collector for owned Discord channels
issues.problem: Syncing your own Discord channels directly inside discord-radar avoids manual JSON exports when building owner voice profiles and owned metrics.
issues.desiredBehavior: Pull messages from owned channel IDs using DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN with Bot prefix validation, pagination cursor tracking, and HTTP 429 Retry-After backoff.
acceptanceCriteria: Support --guild and --channel scoped incremental pulls.
Fail safely with redacted diagnostics when Bot permissions are missing.
issues.verification: Mock Discord REST tests validate incremental pagination and 429 pacing.

issues.title: Harden passive discrawl wiretap local cache wrapper
issues.problem: Daily non owned Discord extraction should require one safe command rather than chaining long shell flags manually.
issues.desiredBehavior: scripts/crawl-wiretap.sh runs discrawl wiretap offline with DISCRAWL_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 and imports non DM rows into SQLite.
acceptanceCriteria: Enforce umask 077 and chmod 600 on wiretap TOML configs.
Filter guild_id != '@me' before piping JSONL into ingest-jsonl.
issues.verification: Shell check and dry JSONL fixture ingest succeed cleanly.

issues.title: Support OpenCLI accessibility trees and Chrome DevTools snapshots
issues.problem: Older web discussions scrolled inside Chrome are cleaner via DOM accessibility trees than Chromium disk cache fragments.
issues.desiredBehavior: parseBrowserSnapshot accepts JSON arrays, OpenCLI accessibility trees, and plain timestamped chat transcripts cleanly.
acceptanceCriteria: Ignore cookies, tokens, and storage keys when parsing snapshot JSON.
Emit normalized records tagged with sourceTier = browser_snapshot.
issues.verification: Unit tests validate all three snapshot input shapes.

issues.title: Guarantee cross tier deduplication and deterministic anonymization
issues.problem: Moving from wiretap capture to Chrome snapshots or later adding a Bot must not duplicate records or leak external handles.
issues.desiredBehavior: Compute deterministic dedup keys and map external speakers to Participant_N while scrubbing handles, IDs, emails, and invites.
acceptanceCriteria: Deduplicate identical messageId entries across wiretap and browser_snapshot tiers.
Strip @mentions, email addresses, and raw snowflakes from non Bot inputs.
issues.verification: Cross tier duplicate test confirms skippedDuplicates increments cleanly.

epics.title: Demand Profiles & Anonymized Signal Radar
epics.summary: Weight and rank captured community chatter against configurable user demand profiles without committing guild or channel IDs.

issues.title: Support local untracked configs/demands.local.json profiles
issues.problem: Target crawl keywords and guild IDs vary per deployment and must stay out of git commits.
issues.desiredBehavior: CLI commands resolve configs/demands.local.json automatically when present while shipping sanitized configs/demands.example.json in Git.
acceptanceCriteria: Ignore configs/*.local.json inside .gitignore.
Allow selecting active profile via --demand <id> or inline --keywords.
issues.verification: bun run targets --json returns loaded demand profiles cleanly.

issues.title: Add structured analytics subcommands (stats, top, export)
issues.problem: Reviewing high volume capture channels needs compact rollups before generating weekly content plans.
issues.desiredBehavior: Implement stats, top channels/topics, and anonymized JSON/Markdown exports matching { ok, schema_version, data }.
acceptanceCriteria: All subcommands emit deterministic JSON in non TTY mode.
Never expose @me DMs or un anonymized external handles in exports.
issues.verification: CLI contract tests verify valid JSON parsing on every subcommand.

issues.title: Refine signal clustering weights across bugs, questions, features, and comparisons
issues.problem: Keyword hits alone miss recency and multi channel signal repetition across communities.
issues.desiredBehavior: Score signal clusters by intent severity, matched demand keywords, message count, and time decay inside src/signals.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: Cluster related discussions under normalized topic keys and category labels.
Include matchedKeywords, channelNames, and scrubbed sampleSnippets.
issues.verification: bun test asserts demand keyword boost elevates matching clusters to rank 1.

epics.title: VoiceGate, Google Translate & Content Brief Synthesis
epics.summary: Keep drafted tutorials and Discord replies authentic to your own voice with strict anti slop gates and token safe Google Translate localization.

issues.title: Build owner style indexer from owned channel history
issues.problem: Generated content briefs sound generic unless anchored to the author's actual tone in owned Discord servers.
issues.desiredBehavior: Analyze only RADAR_OWNER_AUTHOR_ID messages recorded under sourceTier = bot_api to summarize sentence length, greeting style, and code block habits.
acceptanceCriteria: Strictly exclude external wiretap/browser messages when indexing owner voice.
Persist reusable JSON voice profile in .state/voice-profile.json.
issues.verification: Unit test builds deterministic owner style stats from owned fixture messages.

issues.title: Enforce AI slop phrase, dash punctuation, and overlap gates with de-slop cleanup
issues.problem: Generated outlines or drafts must never ship with AI cliché phrasing, dash slop, invisible watermark characters, or verbatim copied member text.
issues.desiredBehavior: checkVoiceGate rejects AI slop phrases, zero width Unicode, em/en dashes, spaced hyphens, HTML tags, and > 12 consecutive overlapping words while stripContentSlop cleans drafts.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect and strip common AI filler phrases and dash punctuation cleanly.
Provide standalone voice-check CLI command for manual drafts.
issues.verification: bun test passes positive and negative voiceGate plus stripContentSlop assertions.

issues.title: Generate multilingual Markdown briefs using Google Translate and token masking
issues.problem: Operators need localized or pivot de-slopped content briefs without corrupting CLI commands, URLs, or Discord #channel names.
issues.desiredBehavior: translateText and translateContentBrief support google_gtx and GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_API_KEY v2 with --lang and --pivot flags while preserving protected tokens verbatim.
acceptanceCriteria: Preserve inline code, fenced code blocks, URLs, and #channel mentions across translation hops.
Support bun run translate and bun run brief --lang <code> [--pivot <code>].
issues.verification: bun test passes single hop, Cloud v2, pivot round trip, and brief translation checks.

epics.title: Daily Digest, MCP Server & Approved Bot Publisher
epics.summary: Integrate discord-radar into coding agents via stdio MCP, daily morning briefs, and dry run by default Bot posting.

issues.title: Implement discord-radar-mcp stdio server for coding agents
issues.problem: Querying your signal vault inside Kiro, Claude Code, or Cursor should happen through direct MCP tool calls rather than manual shell steps.
issues.desiredBehavior: Expose stdio MCP tools for search_radar, list_demands, get_top_signals, generate_brief, translate_text, and check_voice_gate over stdin/stdout JSON-RPC.
acceptanceCriteria: Keep stdout strictly JSON-RPC and route diagnostics to stderr.
Guarantee zero write side effects across read and synthesis MCP tools.
issues.verification: Automated stdio handshake and tool call test passes locally.

issues.title: Add daily content trace digest and randomized 08:00 to 18:00 window scheduler
issues.problem: Daily tracking needs delta comparisons across days without executing at an identical predictable clock minute every morning.
issues.desiredBehavior: Add digest and schedule commands compiling .state/inbox/ plus passive wiretaps into .state/digests/YYYY-MM-DD.{md,json} with topic deltas (new, rising, steady, cooling) triggered once per calendar day at a randomized minute between 08:00 and 18:00 local time.
acceptanceCriteria: Trace day over day post count deltas and render voiceGate checked Markdown and JSON reports.
Enforce strict window boundaries (08:00 to 18:00), pick one independent random minute per calendar day, and support non destructive crontab install.
issues.verification: Integration tests verify inbox archiving, new/rising cluster deltas, 100 random draws inside 08:00 to 18:00, and single execution per day.

issues.title: Add dry run first official Bot publisher with explicit approval gate
issues.problem: Publishing approved briefs into your own Discord channel must never fire accidentally or bypass voiceGate.
issues.desiredBehavior: Default publish commands to preview only and require --live --approvedBy <operator> plus passing voiceGate to send via Bot REST.
acceptanceCriteria: Enforce 5s cooldown and stop immediately on HTTP 429 or 403.
Log published message IDs and approvedBy attribution locally.
issues.verification: Mock REST test confirms dry run default and flag enforcement.
